T3_about.h2: What Biossays E6 Plus is and who it is for
T3_about.text: Biossays E6 Plus is an automated Snibe electrolyte analyzer for measuring Li+, K+, Na+, Cl−, iCa2+ and pH. It accepts serum, whole blood and urine, allowing a laboratory to handle the listed sample types on one system. The analyzer can connect to a laboratory automation track.

rows.label: Analytes
rows.value: Li+, K+, Na+, Cl−, iCa2+, pH

items.text: The system accepts serum, whole blood and urine. This enables the listed sample types to be handled on one electrolyte analyzer. For supported samples, the system measures Li+, K+, Na+, Cl−, iCa2+ and pH.
Biossays E6 Plus can connect to a laboratory automation track and operate within an automated workflow. According to Snibe, the system processes up to 90 samples per hour.

models.text: Explore other Snibe models for biochemistry testing.

items.q: What is the throughput of Biossays E6 Plus?
items.a: Throughput is 540 tests per hour. According to Snibe, the system processes up to 90 samples per hour.

items.q: Which analytes does Biossays E6 Plus measure?
items.a: Biossays E6 Plus measures Li+, K+, Na+, Cl−, iCa2+ and pH.

items.q: Which sample types can Biossays E6 Plus process?
items.a: The analyzer accepts serum, whole blood and urine. The sample volume is 100 µL.

items.q: Can Biossays E6 Plus connect to an automation track?
items.a: Yes. According to Snibe, the analyzer can connect to a laboratory automation track.

items.q: Who supplies and maintains Biossays E6 Plus in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is an official Snibe distributor in Ukraine. It helps select the most effective solution for your needs and provides supply, installation, staff training, warranty and post-warranty maintenance, and application support.

T12_contact.h2: Request a consultation about Biossays E6 Plus
T12_contact.text: Tell us about your sample types, required analytes and testing workload, and we will help assess Biossays E6 Plus for your laboratory and discuss connection to an automation track.
